jurisdiction_name: Australia - Privacy Act 1988 / Australian Privacy Principles (APPs)
description: Australia's Privacy Act 1988, incorporating the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) which regulate the handling of personal information by Australian Government agencies and organisations with an annual turnover of more than $3 million.

child.description: Parental consent required for children under 15

young_adult.description: Individual can consent; parental notification recommended

principles: APP 1 - Open and transparent management of personal information
APP 3 - Collection of solicited personal information
APP 4 - Dealing with unsolicited personal information
APP 5 - Notification of the collection of personal information
APP 6 - Use or disclosure of personal information
APP 8 - Cross-border disclosure of personal information
APP 9 - Adoption, use or disclosure of government related identifiers

privacy_policy.description: Must have a clearly expressed and up-to-date APP Privacy Policy

consent_documentation.description: Must obtain and document consent for collection of sensitive information

collection_notification.description: Must notify individuals at or before time of collection

data_security.description: Must take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, interference, loss, and unauthorised access

access_mechanism.description: Must provide access to personal information held about an individual on request

correction_mechanism.description: Must correct personal information that is inaccurate, out-of-date, incomplete, irrelevant or misleading

cross_border_disclosure.description: Must take reasonable steps to ensure overseas recipients comply with APPs before disclosing personal information

warnings: Privacy Act 1988 and APPs apply to organisations with annual turnover over AUD 3 million
Sensitive information (including health information) requires explicit consent
Must have an APP Privacy Policy freely available to the public
Cross-border disclosures require reasonable steps to ensure overseas recipient compliance
Must not use or disclose personal information for direct marketing without consent
Notifiable Data Breaches (NDB) scheme requires notification to OAIC and affected individuals
Penalties can include fines up to AUD 50 million for serious or repeated breaches
requirements: Maintain a clear and accessible APP Privacy Policy
Collect only information reasonably necessary for functions or activities
Notify individuals of collection, purposes, and how to access/correct data
Obtain explicit consent for sensitive information collection
Protect personal information with reasonable security measures
Destroy or de-identify personal information no longer needed
Provide access to personal information within 30 days of request
Correct inaccurate, outdated, incomplete, or misleading personal information
Notify OAIC and affected individuals of eligible data breaches (NDB scheme)
